_what: when each ASAP dekad was FIRST SEEN published by us. first_seen is an upper bound on the true publication time, never the exact moment, because it depends on when we last probed.
_rule: the staleness bound is 20 days between publications, not 20 days since a dekad label
_backfill_note: Entries marked backfilled were already published when probing began on this date. Their first_seen is the first probe, not the publication, so no age may be computed from them. Ages are meaningful only for dekads first seen after this run.
